scope: Fresh V2 evidence only. V1 timings and failures remain engineering history; no reinterpretation as V2 quality.

budget.deadline: Existing host deadline remains authoritative; this file extends neither time nor spending.

before_first_model: Freeze master after 1990s Chinese menu and current instruments/crop; no further layout features in this experiment
Verify full source, expected Markdown, prose/math/table contracts, confidence receipts and publication license audit; image/reference/source hashes exact
Assign and freeze strict dev/holdout manifests by metadata-only transitive source groups; do not inspect holdout model outputs
Group document continuations, native/capture/crop parents, identical images and shared full photograph/illustration assets. Reused formula/glyph assets do not join whole documents
Retain source_to_cluster/cluster members/join receipts and manifest digests before outputs; preserve original authored source counts and effective cluster counts
Freeze source snapshot hashes, environment versions, model/graph revisions and hardware inventory; one timed job at a time, warmups and CUDA synchronization
No V2 training/calibration data currently assigned: no supervised fine-tune or INT8 calibration is admitted by this plan

environments.torch: base Python: torch2.7.1 CUDA12.8, transformers4.57.6, scipy1.17.1; Heron
environments.ppv3: /workspace/layout-campaign/ppv3-env/bin/python: transformers5.20.2; retain actual torchvision processor metadata
environments.ort_cpu: base Python: onnxruntime1.31.0; tiny ONNX CPU
environments.ort_cuda: /workspace/layout-campaign/ort-gpu-env/bin/python: onnxruntime-gpu1.23.2 for CUDA12; require actual CUDAExecutionProvider as first session provider
environments.verification: Record actual imported module versions per arm, not installed-distribution names alone. Record actual input tensor shape, precision and assigned execution providers.

tiny.name: pp-small-onnx
tiny.batch_execution: fixed1 serial; do not claim GPU batching or FP16 from ignored flags

ppv3.name: ppv3
ppv3.reason: Modern PPv3 runtime has torchvision processor; no fictitious slow/PIL comparison

phases.arms: tiny/heron/ppv3 each independently CPU and CUDA, original bytes, FP32 baseline; no wrappers
phases.cpu_requirement: Measure Heron and PPv3 CPU too. First32-dev canary may bound runtime, then complete same frozen dev manifest when viable. If timeout/OOM retain attempts and explicit limitation, never silently replace with tiny.
phases.gpu_requirement: No CPU fallback for a requested CUDA arm; preserve provider initialization failures.

phases.arms: For the development-selected quality model on each device: orientation-only, rectification-only, figure-classifier-only; same baseline settings and pages
phases.note: Each arm compared with that exact model/device baseline; no combined effect attributed to one component.

phases.arms: Bounded independent knobs, not Cartesian: CPU thread1/2/8 vs4 for selected CPU model; GPU Heron fast-vs-slow, FP16-vs-FP32, batch4-vs1, batch8-vs1 where supported; selected-transformer tensor-size512 and768 vsnative; one combined finalist only after isolated effects
phases.note: Tiny ONNX remains fixed-batch1 graph-defined FP32; only genuine graph optimization would justify a new precision/batch arm.

phases.arms: Selected CPU and GPU profiles each receive deduplicated variants-screen.json plus variants-byte-extreme.json; original arm included in each paired bundle
phases.note: Payload edge/codec/quality/grayscale/palette/bilevel/lossless/AVIF support; producer cost, consumer cost and combined E2E remain separate. Unsupported encoder is runtime failure, not evidence of document difficulty.

phases.arms: Selected CPU/GPU profile plus corresponding unoptimized quality reference, managed resident HTTP vs coldCLI;4 fixed dev image bytes,2repeats,3warmups; optional transformedpayload itself retained and SHA pinned
phases.note: Use transport_benchmark.py in each target runtime environment; no simultaneous managed models, no remote-host network claim from loopback. Rawbytes, responses, hashes, dimensions, fingerprints and cold load retained. A model-only timer cannot stand in for this measurement.

phases.arms: At most two finalists/device using separately justified corrections/runtime/codec, rerun paired against same model full-quality original-input baseline; do not assemble untested combinations.

phases.requires: Exact model/graph/source/config/environment/variant hashes and acceptance policy receipt, before any holdout prediction is produced.

phases.arms: CPU baseline+finalist and GPU baseline+finalist,3fresh paired execution blocks on same frozen heldout groups
phases.note: Same documents across blocks are execution replicates, not independent documents. Use authoritative metadata-only connected components and paired cluster bootstrap; no retuning on holdout.

relative_nonregression.note: Compare against the matched full-quality original-input baseline; strict labels and localization both required. Faster coarse-figure suppression is not a win.

absolute_readiness.scope: heldout only; report confidence intervals and support
absolute_readiness.missing_class_policy: Missing critical-class coverage cannot declare a pass.
absolute_readiness.if_none_pass: Report no broadly ready configuration and separate measured efficiency candidates from readiness.

retention: Raw predictions native labels/confidence/boxes/polygons/native order, unsupported ontology and failures
Independent integrity-gate result and scorer summaries
Bootstrap membership/seed/replicates and paired confidence intervals; selection bias and small-group limitations
baseline_scope: Six total baselines: three models each on CPU and GPU, not six per device.
